title: CI validation and materialized run policy
description:
CI validates schema, contract fixtures, digests and deterministic rendering on every pull request, against a representative pinned smoke subset.

Full materialized-corpus execution is scheduled, manual or release-gated — cloning 29 upstream repositories per pull request is unsuitable, and the existing `benchmark:materialize` is opt-in for that reason.

Any published full baseline must include authenticated materialization validation.
